comment: M07 golden-slice art review. Eye-height spectator views of every beat on the authored route, with the curfew patrol, the only guards placed before their encounter wakes. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m07_declared_goods.json. Look at each still against docs/design/moon.md, the art bible and the Recall Notice bar; this is art review, not combat or fresh-player evidence. The Ranged Sweepers and later guards appear only through the combat route in client/qa/m07_declared_goods.json.

states.name: tunnel_arrival
states.note: Arrival from the transit tunnel: the curved curfew street under the pressure dome, shutters down.

states.name: tunnel_car
states.note: The transit car that brought the party, and the tunnel behind.

states.name: depot_tower
states.note: From the tunnel mouth the depot's radial tower over the town: the level's compass.

states.name: ring_street
states.note: The ring street at the room's entrance: frontage both sides, stalls, porches, every window dark.

states.name: ring_patrol
states.note: The curfew patrol among the stalls: black and red must read against the frontage.

states.name: ring_frontage
states.note: The south frontage at fighting distance: shutters, doors, what people keep at their thresholds.

states.name: ring_porch
states.note: A porch and its stair on the north frontage.

states.name: ring_bend
states.note: The bend toward the market.

states.name: vault_plaza
states.note: The market vault plaza under the dome: the vault, its barriers, stalls.

states.name: vault_plaza_west
states.note: The plaza from the west: the booth, the crate stair, the vault roof.

states.name: side_street
states.note: The quiet side street toward the square.

states.name: window_figure
states.note: The only lit window on the street.

states.name: chalk_alley
states.note: The dead-end alley under the curfew notice and the child's chalk 67.

states.name: square
states.note: The square and the curfew post: a small fortified office, the balcony over its gate.

states.name: post_gate
states.note: The post gate and the Turret balcony from the square.

states.name: lamp_line
states.note: The lamp line across the post and up the lamp stair toward the cut, dark before the post falls.

states.name: sniper_rack
states.note: The curfew post's rack of confiscated long arms, the Sniper Rifle on it.

states.name: post_upper
states.note: The post's upper room and the roof window over the cut.

states.name: roof_window
states.note: From the firing step: across the cut to the depot rim, where the lesson marksman will stand.

states.name: overlook_port
states.note: The roof overlook: the dome and the port's cranes behind and below.

states.name: cut_entry
states.note: The crater cut from its entry: berms, radiation shields, the rim and the depot.

states.name: cut_shield
states.note: Behind the first shield: the rim platforms in the scope's sightline.

states.name: cut_containers
states.note: The cut at fighting distance: shield wall, a container, dust.

states.name: berm_ledge
states.note: The berm-top ledge and its marker post.

states.name: rim_ramp
states.note: The ramp up to the rim.

states.name: rim_back
states.note: From the rim: the cleared cut and the town under its dome behind.

states.name: depot_freight
states.note: The depot's freight approach and its control, into level 8.
